Shein to open first permanent UK store in Manchester

Published 2026-10-06 10:00 UTC

Online fast fashion giant Shein is opening its first permanent shop in the UK, in Manchester's Arndale shopping centre, next month. The company has previously run temporary pop-up stores in London and Birmingham.

Shein, founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, sells most of its clothes through its app. The retailer has faced criticism over working conditions in its supply chain and the environmental impact of fast fashion, which it says it is addressing.

The 1,200 square metre store will employ about 60 people. Retail analysts said the move showed online-first brands were looking to physical shops to reach new customers and cut the cost of returns.
